responsibility: Emits x86 ELF GNU property notes at end of assembly output. This backend helper writes the .note.gnu.property section describing CET features, required x86 ISA level groups, and indirect-extern-access requirements based on the current target flags, and combines that work with exec-stack note emission through file_end_indicate_exec_stack_and_gnu_property, making it the x86-specific metadata emitter for GNU property notes.
